title: Satellite water-signal increase
attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2017), distributed through Earth Search.
metricFormula: sumPositiveDeltaUnits / pairedPixels / 10000; includes zero for observed non-increases.

encoding.input: 16-bit PNG sample 0 = no observation; otherwise MNDWI = (sample − 10001) / 10000. Georeferencing is the scene bbox and display dimensions. No threshold is applied.
encoding.pairedPixels: Both dates have nonzero encoded samples; inherited cloud/shadow/no-data masks must pass on both dates.
encoding.sumDeltaUnits: Sum(after sample − before sample) over jointly observed registered-grid pixels.
encoding.sumPositiveDeltaUnits: Sum(max(after sample − before sample, 0)) over jointly observed registered-grid pixels.
encoding.positivePixels: Count of jointly observed pixels with any positive MNDWI difference; no threshold.
encoding.waterLikeIncreasePixels: Optional heuristic count: after MNDWI > 0 and after − before MNDWI ≥ 0.2. Not used for the primary color metric.
encoding.sumWaterLikePositiveDeltaUnits: Optional sum of positive differences only where after MNDWI > 0; no minimum difference threshold.
encoding.coverage: pairedPixels / pixelCount. Missing cells have zero paired pixels and are UNKNOWN, never zero change or dry ground.
encoding.cellBounds: Use source pixel edges column*cellSize and row*cellSize, clamped to width/height, linearly mapped to bbox. Last cells are smaller.

limitations: This is a numerical before/after spectral comparison, not a trained building-damage model, verified flood extent, damage severity or assistance estimate.
Only jointly clear observations are compared. Missing/cloud-covered samples and areas outside the capture are unknown, never dry or unaffected.
A 64×64 display-pixel cell summarizes its observed samples, not every location in the cell. It does not classify the entire cell as inundated.
20 m native analysis is aggregated to roughly 1.3 km cells. Registered-grid sample counts are not independent native-sensor sample counts.
Positive MNDWI change can include permanent water, wet surfaces, reflectance/seasonal differences, residual cloud effects and registration error. Thresholds are explicitly heuristic.
This product does not establish personal safety, road access, shelter suitability, current conditions or reported assistance need.
